_meta.source: preissuance submission filed 2026-08-02 against US 2026/0109053 A1 (App. 19/315,746)
_meta.methodology: The ten references a patent attorney actually filed, with the claim each was mapped against. This is the only gold set here that is a human expert's finished work product rather than a citation list scraped from a register, which makes it the right thing to score the whole funnel on.
_meta.note: Do not edit after tuning begins. Add a new file for a new subject.

subject.title: Grip unit and vacuum handling apparatus comprising such a grip unit

citations.name: Rotem / GRABO
citations.title: Vacuum gripper
citations.cited_for: hollow grip body, electric vacuum generating device, exhaust guided through the grip to an outlet, pump in one handle section and battery in the other, carrier plate + seal
citations.cpc_note: B25B11/005, B66C1/0287 — inside the seeded branches

citations.name: Hukelmann
citations.title: Sound absorber for vacuum grippers
citations.cited_for: sound-damping device in the grip portion in the exhaust path; grip lined with sound-damping material

citations.name: Crevling Jr.
citations.title: Removable internal air diffuser
citations.cited_for: sound-absorbent material inside the duct leading to the exhaust port rather than a projecting external muffler

citations.name: Sato
citations.title: Sound absorption structure for air flow path in electric air flow generation device
citations.cited_for: double-wall sound absorption section in the exhaust-side air flow path, spanning the joint between two housing sections

citations.name: Sadler
citations.title: Portable hand-held blower/vacuum unit
citations.cited_for: muffler carried inside the upper body portion receiving exhaust and discharging through a front outlet
citations.cpc_note: F04D25/02, A47L5/14 — outside the seeded branches

citations.name: Blatt
citations.title: Vacuum cup venturi assembly and blow off silencer
citations.cited_for: silencer barrel with internal silencing chamber and porous frequency-distorter inserts on the exhaust outlet

citations.name: Perlmutter
citations.title: Vacuum drill plate
citations.cited_for: screw-on muffler/silencer on the vacuum generator's exhaust port
citations.cpc_note: Y10T408/554, B25H1 — outside the seeded branches

citations.name: Bohne / Bosch
citations.title: Electric hand power tool
citations.cited_for: completely hollow auxiliary handle conducting motor cooling air, geometry designed to damp flow noise; spiral expanding air passage into the handle inlet

citations.name: Quackenbush
citations.title: Muffler construction for portable pneumatic tool
citations.cited_for: handle containing both an exhaust passage and a muffler chamber with fibrous material and perforated baffles, exhaust discharged away from the operator — mapped against claims 1, 2, 5, 7 and 8
citations.cpc_note: B25F5/00, B23B45/04 — outside the seeded branches; the attorney's most comprehensive match

citations.name: Cho
citations.title: Vacuum gripper device
citations.cited_for: gripper body + suction plate forming a vacuum chamber, embedded vacuum pump, silencer on the pump exhaust outlet
